expected_behavior: EN plan-progress render request — 'show as a page' phrasing.

query: Give me an HTML dashboard of the ecosystem audit inventory findings.
expected_behavior: EN audit-inventory render request.

query: Turn the coverage matrix into a self-contained HTML page I can open in a browser.
expected_behavior: EN coverage render request — names the coverage matrix target.

query: Genera el dashboard del backlog en HTML para revisarlo visualmente.
expected_behavior: ES backlog render request — cross-lingual triggering.

query: Muéstrame el avance de este plan como una página HTML interactiva.
expected_behavior: ES plan-progress render request.

query: Quiero un tablero HTML del inventario de hallazgos de la auditoría.
expected_behavior: ES audit-inventory render request.

query: Render X as HTML — the backlog board, so the team can filter it without reading raw markdown.
expected_behavior: EN literal 'render X as HTML' phrasing from the description.

query: Add a new item to the backlog: migrate the auth middleware.
expected_behavior: Authoring backlog content — backlog, not a render. Precision check.

query: Create a plan for migrating the backend to GraphQL.
expected_behavior: Planning/authoring — plan, no render angle. Precision check.

query: Run a UX audit of the signup flow.
expected_behavior: Project-state audit — audit, not an HTML render of an inventory. Precision check.

query: Publish this dashboard as a Claude Code Artifact and share it with the team.
expected_behavior: Publishing is a separate explicit ask handled by the Artifact tool, not dash's render trigger; dash never publishes unprompted.

query: Fix this null pointer bug in auth.ts.
expected_behavior: One-off bug fix — bugfix. Precision check.

query: Registra esta solicitud del cliente para agregar exportación a PDF.
expected_behavior: ES stakeholder-request capture — request. Precision check.

query: Necesito ver el tablero de auditoría como una página HTML autocontenida, sin depender de red.
expected_behavior: ES self-contained HTML board request — the dash renderer.

query: Make me a visual board of the plans roll-up I can open in the browser and filter.
expected_behavior: EN board-from-a-.context-tier request. Deterministic renderer route.

query: Genera un reporte HTML del análisis de rendimiento que acabamos de hacer.
expected_behavior: ES ad-hoc report — not a .context/ board, but in scope since the plugin migration: the skill owns the local-first artifact flow, not only the board renderers.

query: Create a chart of our monthly active users from this CSV.
expected_behavior: Generic data visualization with no .context/ board behind it — dataviz, not artifact.

query: Muéstrame el backlog.
expected_behavior: Plain listing request — backlog --list, no rendering asked for. Precision check.

query: The dashboard page renders blank in Safari — figure out why.
expected_behavior: Bug in an existing page — bugfix. The word 'dashboard' is the distractor.

query: Arma una página de consulta con las tres decisiones abiertas del plan de caché para que yo las responda una por una.
expected_behavior: ES consultation-page request: the reader answers items and pastes the reply back (description names consultation pages).

query: Hazme un artefacto sencillo, solo para probar que funciona.
expected_behavior: ES content-free throwaway/test page: still this skill, built locally, never published (description names quick throwaway pages).

query: En la consulta `.context/research/2026-10-09-order-list/consulta.html` cambia la recomendación de Q1: ahora recomiendo «Por fecha de alta». Déjala lista.
expected_behavior: ES change to an existing consultation page (LOOP-012 scn-edit-spec-page): the description names 'a change to an existing artifact page'. The page has a .spec.md, so the edit goes through the spec and a rebuild, never a hand-edit of the built HTML.

query: Add a section to `.context/reports/2026-10-09-status.html` called Risks with these two: the vendor API deprecation and the missing staging data. Leave it ready.
expected_behavior: EN change to an existing HTML report (LOOP-012 scn-edit-html-page): the description's 'add a section to this page' trigger. No .spec.md, so the page stays on the HTML route and is re-wrapped and re-checked, not hand-patched.

query: En el móvil la tabla de `.context/reports/2026-10-09-modes.html` se sale de la pantalla. Corrígela y compruébalo antes de decirme que está bien.
expected_behavior: ES visual complaint about an existing artifact page (LOOP-012 F15, scn-visual-complaint): the description names 'a change to an existing artifact page, even a visual one'. The kit's probe, check and wrap measure the fix, not an ad-hoc Playwright script; not ui-contract.

query: The settings screen of our app overflows horizontally on mobile. Fix it and show me before and after.
expected_behavior: App-screen visual defect with no `.context/` page: ui-contract owns it (before/after contact sheet). The overflow wording alone is not an artifact trigger.
